## `decode`

Defined in `balsa.packed`.

```mojo
def decode[dtype: DType = DType.float32](var data: List[UInt8], limits: Limits = Limits(Int(67108864), Int(8388608), Int(100000), Int(1000000), Int(1024)), options: ValidationOptions = ValidationOptions(Int(4), Int(4096), Int(65536), enabled=False)) raises -> PackedModel[dtype]
```

Own checkpoint bytes with bounds checks; semantic validation is opt-in.

```mojo
def decode[origin: ImmOrigin, //, dtype: DType = DType.float32](data: Span[UInt8, origin], limits: Limits = Limits(Int(67108864), Int(8388608), Int(100000), Int(1000000), Int(1024)), options: ValidationOptions = ValidationOptions(Int(4), Int(4096), Int(65536), enabled=False)) raises -> PackedModel[dtype]
```

Copy borrowed input once so the packed result owns its bytes.

### `validate`

```mojo
def validate(self, options: ValidationOptions = ValidationOptions(Int(4), Int(4096), Int(65536), enabled=False)) raises
```

Check semantics serially using one reusable tree and topology scratch.

Always checks, even with enabled=False. max_workers is a cap; this
representation currently uses one worker. No editable forest is built.

## `decode_editable`

Defined in `balsa.codec`.

```mojo
def decode[dtype: DType = DType.float32](var data: List[UInt8], limits: Limits = Limits(Int(67108864), Int(8388608), Int(100000), Int(1000000), Int(1024)), options: ValidationOptions = ValidationOptions(Int(4), Int(4096), Int(65536), enabled=False)) raises -> Model[dtype]
```

Decode editable fields; automatic semantic validation is opt-in.

Wire bounds, format checks and parser limits always apply. Precision must
match the file tags. A skipped validation pass can be run with validate().

```mojo
def decode[origin: ImmOrigin, //, dtype: DType = DType.float32](data: Span[UInt8, origin], limits: Limits = Limits(Int(67108864), Int(8388608), Int(100000), Int(1000000), Int(1024)), options: ValidationOptions = ValidationOptions(Int(4), Int(4096), Int(65536), enabled=False)) raises -> Model[dtype]
```

Borrow checkpoint bytes and return independently owned model fields.

## `decode_into`

Defined in `balsa.codec`.

```mojo
def decode_into[dtype: DType, origin: ImmOrigin](mut model: Model[dtype], data: Span[UInt8, origin], limits: Limits = Limits(Int(67108864), Int(8388608), Int(100000), Int(1000000), Int(1024)), options: ValidationOptions = ValidationOptions(Int(4), Int(4096), Int(65536), enabled=False)) raises
```

Decode into owned storage, reusing existing field capacities.

On failure fields may be partially updated and must not be used as a valid
model. The destination remains safe to destroy or pass to decode_into again.
Input bytes are borrowed only for this call. All parser checks still apply.

## `Model`

Defined in `balsa.model`.

```mojo
struct Model[dtype: DType]
```

Owned model fields, validated by the codec.

Traits: `AnyType`, `Copyable`, `Deinitable`, `Movable`.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `major` | `Int32` | Treelite checkpoint major version, independent of Balsa version. |
| `minor` | `Int32` | Treelite checkpoint minor version. |
| `patch` | `Int32` | Treelite checkpoint patch version. |
| `threshold_type` | `UInt8` | TypeInfo tag matching the model dtype. |
| `leaf_output_type` | `UInt8` | TypeInfo tag matching the model dtype. |
| `num_tree` | `UInt64` | Number of trees; must equal the trees list length. |
| `num_feature` | `Int32` | Number of input features. |
| `task_type` | `UInt8` | TaskType code preserved as model metadata. |
| `average_tree_output` | `UInt8` | Wire boolean indicating averaged tree output. |
| `num_target` | `Int32` | Number of output targets. |
| `num_class` | `List[Int32]` | Class count for each target. |
| `leaf_vector_shape` | `List[Int32]` | Two dimensions describing a vector leaf output. |
| `target_id` | `List[Int32]` | Per-tree target annotation; -1 denotes all targets. |
| `class_id` | `List[Int32]` | Per-tree class annotation; -1 denotes all classes. |
| `postprocessor` | `List[UInt8]` | Postprocessor name bytes; Balsa never executes the postprocessor. |
| `sigmoid_alpha` | `Float32` | Stored postprocessor coefficient. |
| `ratio_c` | `Float32` | Stored postprocessor coefficient. |
| `base_scores` | `List[Float64]` | Base score array with num_target * max(num_class) entries. |
| `attributes` | `List[UInt8]` | Opaque attribute JSON bytes; not parsed or validated as JSON. |
| `extensions` | `List[Extension]` | Opaque records in the model extension slot. |
| `trees` | `List[Tree[dtype]]` | Owned trees in serialization order. |

## `Tree`

Defined in `balsa.model`.

```mojo
struct Tree[dtype: DType]
```

Owned tree fields, validated by the codec.

Traits: `AnyType`, `Copyable`, `Deinitable`, `Movable`.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `num_nodes` | `Int32` | Number of nodes; node zero is the root. |
| `has_categorical_split` | `UInt8` | Wire boolean indicating whether the tree contains categorical splits. |
| `node_type` | `List[Int8]` | Per-node NodeType code. |
| `cleft` | `List[Int32]` | Per-node left child index; -1 for leaves. |
| `cright` | `List[Int32]` | Per-node right child index; -1 for leaves. |
| `split_index` | `List[Int32]` | Per-node feature index for split nodes. |
| `default_left` | `List[UInt8]` | Per-node wire boolean selecting the left branch for missing values. |
| `leaf_value` | `List[Scalar[dtype]]` | Per-node scalar leaf value. |
| `threshold` | `List[Scalar[dtype]]` | Per-node numerical split threshold. |
| `cmp` | `List[Int8]` | Per-node Operator code for numerical splits. |
| `category_list_right_child` | `List[UInt8]` | Per-node wire boolean: category membership selects the right child. |
| `leaf_vector` | `List[Scalar[dtype]]` | Concatenated vector-leaf values. |
| `leaf_vector_begin` | `List[UInt64]` | Per-node inclusive offset into leaf_vector. |
| `leaf_vector_end` | `List[UInt64]` | Per-node exclusive offset into leaf_vector. |
| `category_list` | `List[UInt32]` | Concatenated categorical split IDs. |
| `category_list_begin` | `List[UInt64]` | Per-node inclusive offset into category_list. |
| `category_list_end` | `List[UInt64]` | Per-node exclusive offset into category_list. |
| `data_count` | `List[UInt64]` | Optional per-node sample counts, paired with data_count_present. |
| `data_count_present` | `List[UInt8]` | Presence flags for data_count; both arrays may be empty. |
| `sum_hess` | `List[Float64]` | Optional per-node Hessian sums, paired with sum_hess_present. |
| `sum_hess_present` | `List[UInt8]` | Presence flags for sum_hess; both arrays may be empty. |
| `gain` | `List[Float64]` | Optional per-node gains, paired with gain_present. |
| `gain_present` | `List[UInt8]` | Presence flags for gain; both arrays may be empty. |
| `tree_extensions` | `List[Extension]` | Opaque records in the tree extension slot. |
| `node_extensions` | `List[Extension]` | Opaque records in the node extension slot. |

## `ModelBuilder`

Defined in `balsa.builder`.

```mojo
struct ModelBuilder[dtype: DType = DType.float32]
```

Build a model with derived tree/target counts and default scalar metadata.

Traits: `AnyType`, `Deinitable`, `Movable`.

### `__init__`

```mojo
def __init__(out self, num_feature: Int32, *, task_type: UInt8 = TaskType.REGRESSOR, average_tree_output: Bool = False, var num_class: List[Int32] = List(Int32(1), __list_literal__=NoneType(None)), var leaf_vector_shape: List[Int32] = List(Int32(1), Int32(1), __list_literal__=NoneType(None)), var base_scores: List[Float64] = List(), postprocessor: String = "identity", sigmoid_alpha: Float32 = Float32("1"), ratio_c: Float32 = Float32("1"), attributes: String = "", limits: Limits = Limits(Int(67108864), Int(8388608), Int(100000), Int(1000000), Int(1024))) raises
```

Initialize and validate metadata for a model without trees.

num_class defines one entry per target. Empty base_scores become zeros
with num_target * max(num_class) entries. List arguments are consumed.
Postprocessor settings are stored as metadata and never executed.


## `TreeBuilder`

Defined in `balsa.builder`.

```mojo
struct TreeBuilder[dtype: DType = DType.float32]
```

Fill dense node IDs in any order; node 0 is the root.

Each node must be defined exactly once. build() checks completeness;
ModelBuilder.build() checks topology, features and output shapes.

Traits: `AnyType`, `Deinitable`, `Movable`.


### `categorical_split`

```mojo
def categorical_split(mut self, node: Int, *, feature: Int32, categories: List[UInt32], left: Int32, right: Int32, default_left: Bool = False, categories_right: Bool = False) raises
```

Define a categorical split, copying category IDs into tree storage.

Membership selects the right child when categories_right is True,
otherwise the left child. default_left selects the missing-value branch.

## `validate`

Defined in `balsa.validation`.

```mojo
def validate[dtype: DType](model: Model[dtype], limits: Limits = Limits(Int(67108864), Int(8388608), Int(100000), Int(1000000), Int(1024)), options: ValidationOptions = ValidationOptions(Int(4), Int(4096), Int(65536), enabled=False)) raises
```

Reject malformed metadata, lengths, topology and segment offsets.

Always validates, including when options.enabled is False.

## `ValidationOptions`

Defined in `balsa.validation`.

```mojo
struct ValidationOptions
```

Control automatic model validation and its concurrency per call.

Codec calls skip semantic validation by default (enabled=False).
Pass enabled=True for untrusted or uncertain inputs. Builders and packed
to_model() explicitly default to checked construction/conversion.
Explicit validate() always checks the model, regardless of enabled.
Thresholds apply together. The shared runtime may use fewer workers.

Traits: `AnyType`, `Copyable`, `Deinitable`, `Movable`.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `Bool` | Whether codec and builder calls validate automatically; default False. |
| `max_workers` | `Int` | Per-call worker cap; values <= 1 select serial validation. |
| `min_trees` | `Int` | Minimum tree count for parallel validation; default 4,096. |
| `min_nodes` | `Int` | Minimum total node count for parallel validation; default 65,536. |

### `__init__`

```mojo
def __init__(out self, max_workers: Int = Int(4), min_trees: Int = Int(4096), min_nodes: Int = Int(65536), *, enabled: Bool = False)
```

Set automatic validation policy and parallel execution thresholds.

max_workers <= 1 selects serial execution. Both thresholds must be met
and no tree may contain more than half the nodes to use parallelism.

```mojo
struct Limits
```
